purpose: Pilot background-supervised frame opinions without modifying frozen inherited detectors or caches
feature_extraction: Concatenate spatial mean and max of every frozen neck map entering Detect, in released scale order; eval mode; standardize on sampled training features only
label: original sensor-specific frame presence; class order UAV, background
candidate_policy: Preserve inherited candidate boxes and scores as reference; frame opinions exist independently of box availability
missing_policy: No box: retain frame opinion, objectness zero and training-fitted missing spatial code; sensor dropout: zero beliefs, uncertainty one, no box or inference
optimizer: Adam; full sampled training batch; gradient norm cap 10
loss: Expected Dirichlet cross entropy + min(1,epoch/10) KL to uniform with true-class evidence removed; class-stratified training weighted to original training sensor prevalence
checkpoint_selection: Fixed final pilot epoch; validation does not select checkpoint
validation: At most 128 samples per sensor-specific class for recall and prevalence-weighted Brier; first/middle/last frames of all 67 sequences for paired clean and severity-3 noise/blur diagnostics
both_class_gate: Each sensor: UAV recall > 0.5, background recall > 0.5, prevalence-weighted Brier below constant validation-prevalence predictor
opposition_diagnostic: Opposite strict probability decisions around 0.5; confident opposite decisions require p_UAV>=0.7 in one sensor and <=0.3 in the other
policy: Nonzero inherited conflict alone is not a success criterion. Report all support counts and degree of conflict. Do not guarantee or manufacture conflict; test remains locked. Production protocol/cache changes require pilot review.
